verdict.rationale: Cursor Automations, rules, and skills are version-controlled artifacts (skills are described as 'portable, version-controlled packages') and automations can be toggled/managed, but there is no documented review workflow, diff/version history UI, or rollback mechanism specifically for automations themselves (as opposed to code changes via git/worktrees). missing for 10: a dedicated automation version-history or audit trail, an explicit rollback/revert feature for automation configs, and any review/approval flow for changes to automations before they take effect.
